'''Gwori Revolutionary Industries''' was a ship manufacturer based on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Gwori]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the company aligned itself with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and constructed [[Starship/Legends|starships]] for use against the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
Based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gwori]], Revolutionary Industries had a long standing relationship with the [[Muun/Legends|Muuns]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] and profited greatly from an alliance with [[Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc./Legends|Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc.]]. Constructing massive shipyards as revenue flowed, Revolutionary Industries prospered during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] which plagued the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as Banking Clan [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] commissioned the construction of several [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]].<ref name="ROTSIC" />

When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Revolutionary Industries continued to produce for the Banking Clan, providing the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] with communications frigates to use against the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. During the early stages of the war, the largest shipyards of the Confederacy were owned by Gwori and produced the most ships for the Navy. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Gwori shipyards]] were managed by [[Overseer/Legends|Overseer]] [[Juhm]] when a Republic spy infiltrated the compound and leaked vital information to the Republic. Launching an [[Battle of Gwori|assault]] on the planet, Overseer Juhm was helpless to stop an attack group led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] and watched in horror as the shipyards were destroyed.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Shipyards of Doom">''[[The Clone Wars: Shipyards of Doom]]''</ref>
